title: 31 Bluejack Street Vacation Rental
meta_description: 31 Bluejack Street is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12)- 6 Passenger Street Legal Golf Cart Included- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 2 Vehicles- Exterior Shower- Sprawling Porches- Propane Gas Grill- Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Lake District- Steps to Frog Pool- 3 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 6 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access- 8 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 31 Bluejack Street, a beautifully appointed five-bedroom, five-bathroom retreat tucked into the heart of WaterColor’s Lake District. Just steps from the peaceful Frog Pool and a short bike ride to Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club, this home offers the ideal blend of comfort, luxury, and convenience for up to 12 guests. Spacious porches, a 6-passenger street-legal golf cart, and six adult bikes set the tone for easy exploration and relaxed coastal living. Inside, an open-concept layout creates a light, airy atmosphere, featuring designer furnishings, hardwood floors, and thoughtful touches throughout. The fully equipped kitchen includes custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and premium stainless steel appliances, with a large island that seats six. The adjacent dining area and living room provide ample space to gather, unwind, and enjoy time together. French doors lead to a screened porch that’s perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails. On the first floor, you’ll find a king suite with a private bathroom and walk-in shower, as well as a queen guest room with its own en suite bath. Upstairs, two additional living areas include a queen sleeper sofa, wet bar, refrigerator, and a second washer and dryer—perfect for extended stays. Three more guest suites—two with king beds and one with a queen—each offer private bathrooms with walk-in showers for ultimate comfort and privacy. When you're ready to explore, take a short ride to the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, or the vibrant community of Seaside just minutes away. WaterColor’s scenic trails, community pools, and access to the sugar-white beaches of 30A make it easy to enjoy everything this iconic destination has to offer. Our team is here to help make your stay seamless—from pre-arrival tips to local recommendations, we’re happy to assist with anything you need along the way. At 31 Bluejack Street, you’ll find the space, style, and setting to create lasting memories with the people who matter most. FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo- Kitchen- Living Room- Dining Room- Laundry Room SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Sitting Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa (2)- Living Room with Refrigerator, Dishwasher and Bar Area- Stackable Washer/Dryer Closet
